The Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association presents the Genki Experience Festival at Saitama Prefectural Nagurigenkiplaza (名栗げんきプラザ). The theme is "Community × Experience." Visitors can enjoy a variety of hands-on activities including fire-making, wood-splitting, crafts, and tortilla-making (limited to 200 servings). Pre-registration is required to participate.

For details and registration, visit: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e3%81%92%e3%82%93%e3%81%8d%e4%bd%93%e9%a8%93%e3%83%95%e3%82%a7%e3%82%b9%e3%83%86%e3%82%a3%e3%83%90%e3%83%ab%ef%bc%a0%e5%90%8d%e6%a0%97%e3%81%92%e3%82%93%e3%81%8d%e3%83%97%e3%83%a9%e3%82%b6%e3%80%8010
